title: Check-ins
summary: Messages the coach starts on its own, at most once a day.
description: A proactive coach that sends a message per rule gets muted. So rules only propose, and one local pass picks at most one to speak; the model is asked only to phrase the winner.

requirements.text: The coach starts at most `checkin.daily-budget` check-in a day, whatever fires.
Whether to send a check-in is decided by plain comparisons over the digest, without a model.
Every firing trigger that doesn't win is passed to the winning check-in as material.
A condition trigger has a cooldown, so it raises one thing once rather than every day until fixed.
On Android the check-in is evaluated once a day at a user-set hour, defaulting to `checkin.default-hour`, even when the app is not running.
A check-in is saved as a new chat, never appended to the chat the user has open.
Tapping a check-in's notification opens that check-in's chat.
An unread check-in shows as unread on the Coach tab, also when its notification was dismissed.
